title: MarketObservation
description: What an agent sees at one point-in-time decision step. All data is point-in-time: close_history, fundamentals and news only ever hold information available at or before `date`. This schema is authoritative for the SharpeBench agent wire contract and is closed: the Rust types carry #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)].

date.description: ISO-8601 date of the decision point.

symbols.description: Point-in-time snapshot per tradable instrument. The set of symbols here is the universe an order may name.

close_history.description: Trailing closes up to and including `date` (oldest first).

fundamentals.description: Named fundamental fields (e.g. `pe`, `revenue_yoy`). Optional; defaults to empty.

news.description: Headlines published on or before `date`. Optional; defaults to empty.

shares.description: Signed share count; negative is a short position.

avg_price.description: Average entry price for the position.
